title: A nuclear warhead hits Washington: where the government goes in the first 30 minutes

strikes.weapon: Generic submarine-launched ballistic missile, one warhead (attacker unnamed)
strikes.notes: Simulation choice: one 100 kt airburst over central Washington, no attacker named. Flight time from the engine; research.md A7 gives about 10 to 15 minutes from an offshore submarine (CRS: roughly 15). Hero strike for the ring-by-ring close-up. Raven Rock (A13) and Mount Weather (A14) are not struck.

model: Glasstone and Dolan scaling calibrated to NUKEMAP Hiroshima figures; flight times fitted to published ranges; all values are estimates for a labelled simulation.
